name: Wolverine Stack
description: A frequently discussed tissue-repair pairing. In preclinical research, BPC-157 has been studied for effects on blood-vessel formation and TB-500 for its role in cell migration. Human evidence is limited.

name: GH Pulse Stack
description: A commonly researched growth-hormone pairing. CJC-1295 acts on the GHRH receptor and Ipamorelin on the ghrelin receptor; studies have looked at how the two pathways combine. Evidence in healthy adults is limited.

name: Cognitive Edge
description: A stress-and-cognition pairing. Semax has been studied for effects on BDNF and dopaminergic signalling, and Selank for GABA-related activity. Most research comes from small studies.

name: Extended Wolverine
description: The Wolverine pairing plus GHK-Cu, which has been studied for its effects on collagen synthesis in lab and skin research. Human evidence for the combination is limited.

name: Longevity Protocol
description: A longevity-themed combination. Epitalon has been researched for telomerase activity, GHK-Cu for collagen and gene-expression effects, and BPC-157 in preclinical cytoprotection studies. Human evidence is limited.

name: Immune Defense
description: An immune-themed combination. Thymosin alpha-1 has been studied for T-cell effects, LL-37 for antimicrobial activity, and KPV for inflammatory signalling. Human evidence for the combination is limited.

name: Performance Stack
description: A training-recovery combination pairing the Wolverine peptides with CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin, each studied for different recovery and growth-hormone pathways. Human evidence for the combination is limited.

name: Body Composition
description: A body-composition combination. AOD-9604 has been studied for fat metabolism and CJC-1295/Ipamorelin for growth-hormone release. Clinical results have been mixed.

name: Joint Recovery
description: A joint-themed combination. BPC-157 has been studied in preclinical tendon and ligament models, GHK-Cu for collagen synthesis, and AOD-9604 in early cartilage research. Human evidence is limited.

name: Gut + Immune
description: A gut-immune combination. BPC-157 has been studied in preclinical GI models, KPV for intestinal inflammation, and thymosin alpha-1 for immune function. Human evidence is limited.

name: Pulse GH (Non-DAC)
description: A shorter-acting variant of the GH pairing using Mod GRF 1-29 with a GHRP, researched for a more pulsatile release pattern. Evidence in healthy adults is limited.

name: Full Recovery
description: A broad recovery combination of the Wolverine peptides, GHK-Cu and Ipamorelin, each studied for a different part of tissue recovery. Human evidence for the combination is limited.
